title: Tech Note: Cal4D Component - User Reference
author: Dave Batton (Cal4D component author)

historical_commentary.text: This is Part One of a two-part note introducing the Cal4D calendar component for 4D 2004, covering installation and basic use of the full-featured calendar it adds to a 4D database, with source code included under 4D's Partnerware license agreement. Only the short teaser abstract is available in this archive because the original self-extracting .exe distribution was not accessible in this environment, so installation and usage details cannot be verified here. As with its companion Part Two note, this documents a third-party component built for classic 4D 2004 (pre-Project Mode, pre-ORDA), making its specific instructions obsolete for current 4D development even though the general idea of adding calendar UI via a reusable component remains a common pattern today.
related_updates: The full archive for this note could not be recovered in this environment (old self-extracting .exe format), so only the teaser text is available
Cal4D was a third-party Partnerware component for 4D 2004; modern 4D calendar/scheduling needs would use current, actively maintained components or built-in form objects instead
